rules.statement: In an action to revoke a deed of gift based on gross ingratitude, the cause of action survives upon the death of the original Defendant.
rules.supporting_quote: In terms of Section 398(1) (a) of the Civil Procedure Code, in the event of the death of a sole Defendant, an application can be made for substitution of the legal representatives of the deceased Defendant, on the condition that the right to sue survives.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 398(1) (a) of the Civil Procedure Code
